jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Us Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to work closely with automotive OEMs, develop firmware and integrate OEM middleware with sensor firmware. You will be responsible for implementing software components, debugging integration issues, and ensuring the system meets automotive security and compliance requirements. What You’ll Be Doing Develop Lidar firmware and support OEM for vehicle integration. Support hardware bring-up, bootloader integration, and RTOS-level testing for embedded systems on multi-core ARM platforms. Participate in the full software lifecycle—requirements definition, design documentation, test planning, implementation, and peer review. What You Have 5–8 years of experience in embedded C/C++ development for automotive or real-time systems. Strong understanding of AUTOSAR architecture and middleware integration. Experience developing software for Embedded Linux/QNX on ARM-based SoCs. Familiarity with secure boot, key management, and in-vehicle communication security (SecOC, MACSEC). Knowledge of RTOS, Ethernet, and hardware abstraction layers. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in cross-functional, OEM-collaborative environments. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across hardware, software, and systems teams. Worum es geht Die Symporo Gruppe vereint 13 regionale Catering-Marken mit über 1.400 Mitarbeitenden an acht Standorten. jobs.description: EU Remote (CET preferred) · German & English · Full-time Competitive salary · Early equity YOUR MISSION A software engineer today works alongside Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still clicks through CAD trees, searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest. We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products : one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers. The interaction model is still an open problem. How does an engineer give an agent context, steer its work and understand what changed? How much should the agent figure out itself? And how does all of this fit into existing CAD and engineering workflows? You will work directly with founders, engineers and customers to figure that out and turn it into a product people can actually use. You are our first full-time product designer. We want someone with a point of view who can help shape the direction, not someone waiting for a finished brief. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON You will work across discovery, interaction design and shipped product. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but these are the kinds of problems in front of us: How engineers work with AI agents in 3D. Briefing, steering, reviewing and understanding agent work without turning the product into another complex engineering tool. Connecting AI into real engineering workflows. Spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, test ideas early and turn what you learn into better product decisions. Prototyping new interaction models. Sometimes that means Figma, sometimes a rough prototype in code, sometimes pairing directly with an engineer. Use whatever gets us to an answer fastest. Aber KI entwickelt sich so rasant, dass die meisten Belegschaften kaum noch Schritt halten. Als Teil von Multiverse ist StackFuel Deutschlands führender Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung. 2017 in Berlin gegründet, haben wir bereits über 8.000 Absolvent:innen weitergebildet, mit einer Abschlussquote von über 90 % bei Unternehmen wie der Deutschen Bahn, Mercedes-Benz und Telefónica. Seit 2026 gehören wir zu Multiverse und bauen gemeinsam den KI-Adoption-Layer für Europa auf: das fehlende Bindeglied zwischen den KI-Tools, in die Unternehmen investiert haben, und den Menschen, die sie im Arbeitsalltag nutzen sollen. Multiverse hat im April 2026 seine jüngste Finanzierungsrunde abgeschlossen und wird mit 2,1 Mrd. US-Dollar bewertet. Insgesamt haben wir über 500 Mio. US-Dollar von Investoren wie Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital und Lightspeed eingesammelt. Wir wollen 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland für das KI-Zeitalter weiterbilden: mit einem Team, das den deutschen Markt kennt, und einem starken Partner im Rücken, der uns Tempo ermöglicht. jobs.description: Warum re-green? re-green steigert nachhaltig den Wert großer Immobilienportfolios durch wirtschaftliche energetische Sanierung. Wir ermöglichen Eigentümern, ihre Gebäude ohne eigenen Investitionsbedarf zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Unsere vorgefertigten Energiemodule kombinieren Photovoltaik, bivalente Wärmepumpen und intelligente Energiemanagementsysteme – skalierbar umgesetzt und gesteuert durch unsere eigene Software. Die Refinanzierung erfolgt über langfristige Strom- und Wärmelieferverträge zu Preisen unter dem deutschen Durchschnitt. jobs.description: Ready to build data platforms, not just pipelines? At Opencast, we believe great data engineering is about more than moving and transforming data. It's about creating reliable, scalable foundations that help organisations make better decisions and deliver better services. You’ll tackle complex engineering challenges across integration, migration, modelling and platform design, working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure and modern data technologies. We value engineering craft, thoughtful problem-solving and building solutions that are simple, robust and built to last. Our data engineering capability is growing, and you'll help guide its direction through mentoring, recruitment and technical leadership, as well as your client work. If you want to shape both the solutions and capability around them, this could be the role for you. The role Opencast data engineers help organisations transform how they manage, use and learn from data. The work ranges from building modern lakehouse and warehouse platforms in Microsoft Fabric to modernising legacy environments, migrating complex workloads and improving the quality, governance and reliability of critical data services. This role offers the opportunity to work across the full data lifecycle, combining platform design, engineering, integration and optimisation. Expect to work with structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, building batch and near real-time data pipelines that underpin critical business and public services. You'll collaborate with architects, analysts, software engineers and client teams to solve complex challenges and influence technical direction. The role also offers opportunities to contribute beyond delivery through mentoring, recruitment, community building and helping to define engineering standards and best practice as our capability continues to grow. jobs.description: Are you a natural leader with a strong network, driven to tackle your city's biggest challenges and connect diverse groups to make things happen? If so, you belong at Venture Café! At Venture Café, we aim to create a global community of innovators with equal access to resources and opportunities, addressing our most pressing challenges. Ready to make an impact with us? The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. This is a unique opportunity to operate and grow a hub for Deeptech innovation and connection, in close collaboration with ARIA . ABOUT VENTURE CAFÉ Venture Café believes that Isolation is the enemy of innovation and our mission is clear: Connect innovators to make things happen. We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone. Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. Featuring vibrant networking sessions activated with captivating demos or immersion in the night’s theme by attending thought-provoking sessions led by inspiring speakers. Here, curiosity meets opportunity, connections flourish, and innovation thrives. Venture Café was founded by Tim Rowe, founder and CEO of the Cambridge Innovation Center (CIC), in 2009 and helped fuel the growth of one of the world’s most powerful innovation ecosystems: Boston’s Kendall Square. What began with a modest gathering of 12 people at our inaugural Thursday Gathering has flourished into the Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI). Over the past 15 years, VCGI has united over 900,000 visionaries, developers, creatives, and civic leaders across 24cities worldwide, building a global community of communities. We give marketing teams one clear, daily view of what s actually working - across every channel and everywhere they sell, from their website to Amazon and TikTok Shop - down to the level of a single ad or piece of creative. We re looking for people who will push how we structure and execute to maximise the value of Product work, not take their first step into Product management. What you ll do Own a product area end to end. Take initiatives from problem, sizing and discovery through build, launch and adoption. We invest in software companies with roughly €2–10 million in ARR and work alongside their founders after the investment. jobs.title: Auditeur préleveur (H/F) en restauration collective
jobs.description: Le Groupe QUALTECH - 5 sociétés, 7 sites et 350 salariés - est un regroupement de Laboratoires spécialisés dans les analyses de laboratoire (microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie, extraction d’ADN, etc), le conseil, la recherche et la formation. Notre but est de garantir une expertise qualitative à nos clients en termes de contrôle, de qualité et de fiabilité dans le secteur de l’agro-alimentaire. Nos valeurs : intégrité, innovation, expertise, engagement, orientation client. En rejoignant son laboratoire AGROBIO spécialisé en microbiologie, vous participez à son expertise dans le monde de la recherche et de l’analyse agro-alimentaire. Vos missions Dans le cadre d’un remplacement au sein de notre laboratoire AGROBIO, nous vous attendons pour prélever des échantillons (alimentaires, d’eau et de surface) et réaliser des audits d’hygiène chez nos clients situés dans un rayon de 120 km autour de Quimper. Vous allez avoir l’opportunité de rencontrer les différents acteurs locaux et de découvrir leur activité, qu’ils soient spécialisés dans la restauration collective (crèches, lycées, maisons de retraite, restaurants d’entreprise, armé, abattoirs, etc.) ou plus traditionnelle. Vous êtes le 1er maillon de cette longue chaîne menant à une analyse de haute fiabilité grâce à la collaboration de chacun. Derrière vous, une équipe logistique présente à tout moment pour vous aider, des techniciens de laboratoire impatients de traiter vos échantillons et des clients à rassurer sur leurs bonnes pratiques vis-à-vis du grand public. Des outils de travail vous sont attribués : un véhicule de service, une carte carburant et de télépéage, un téléphone, une tablette, et des paniers repas pour chaque journée de travail de plus de 6 heures. Enfin, une formation sera assurée en interne à votre prise de poste. La connaissance de la méthode HACCP sera considérée comme un atout dans votre candidature. Le métier en images : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vioxi-NwhKw Type de contrat : CDD

You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. As a Software Engineer at GIGA Storage, these are the challenges you will work on. We take ownership, share knowledge and make decisions together. Rapid growth also calls for adaptability: priorities shift and not everything is defined in advance. Your role You develop and grow our Giga platform. You build software in Python, working with technologies including SQL, Terraform, Grafana and data processing. You do not need to know everything already: you enjoy learning beyond your own specialism. What will you work on? At the same time, you strengthen the foundations: fewer manual steps, better-documented code and reusable solutions for future sites. We work by the principle ‘you build it, you run it’. We're profitable and entering new markets, but we're not planning significant headcount growth. Right now, we're a team of 35 people spread globally. Small enough to know each other's names, big enough to have real impact. As we grow, everything changes. How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here. You will: Run the full employee lifecycle end-to-end: attraction, recruitment (with budget for external support on specialised roles), onboarding, development, performance, engagement and offboarding. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team. You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together. Our current data platform includes: Ingestion: Stitch Data warehouse: BigQuery Transformation: dbt Cloud Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight What you’ll do Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion. Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page. Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making. Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business. AI-Ready Data: Name, describe and define our data clearly and consistently, so that colleagues and AI tools can ask questions of it and get the right answer. Champion

jobs.title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
jobs.description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation. Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through. We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. What You'll Do Keep things running Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks. Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips. Seit 25 Jahren bringen wir diese Expertise mit einem großartigen Team zu den besten Kunden der Welt. Marken wie Dr. Oetker, Mattel, Bauck, Andros und Chio vertrauen auf uns. Leidenschaft: Wir geben aus Überzeugung das Beste für unsere Kunden und unser Team. Worum es geht Wir suchen einen Projektmanager in Vollzeit , der seine Aktionen von A bis Z in der Hand hat. Du planst, konzipierst und steuerst Roadshows, POS-Aktionen, Promotions und Verkostungen und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende alles rund läuft. jobs.title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) im Hochbau
jobs.description: Du steuerst Bauprojekte ins Ziel – mit einem klaren Plan, einem starken Team und fundiertem Praxiswissen. Wir suchen Dich: Projektleiter (m/w/d) im Hochbau DEINE MISSION: PROJEKTE FÜHREN, DIE BEWEGEN Du koordinierst, entscheidest und hältst die Fäden auf der Baustelle fest in der Hand. Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte und stellst eine qualitativ hochwertige, termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Umsetzung sicher – von Projektbeginn bis zur erfolgreichen Übergabe. Projektmanagement: Dein Projekt hast Du im Griff – das Leistungsverzeichnis sitzt, den Status quo kennst Du genau. Entscheidungen triffst Du zielsicher, auf Veränderungen reagierst Du flexibel und agil. Klare Worte, gutes Team: Als zentrale Schnittstelle kommunizierst Du offen mit Auftraggebern, Planern, Nachunternehmern und Deinem Team – transparent, direkt und wertschätzend. Controlling mit Weitblick: Du stellst die Wirtschaftlichkeit des Projekts sicher und gewährleistest eine nachvollziehbare, termingerechte Abrechnung. DEIN PROFIL: ERFAHRUNG TRIFFT AUF MACHER-MENTALITÄT Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bauingenieurwesen, Projektmanagement Bau oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen – oder bist Meister bzw. Techniker – und punktest mit echtem Fachwissen. Erfahrung: Du kennst den Hochbau aus der Praxis – mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung als Projektleiter, insbesondere im Beton-, Fassaden- oder Schalungsbau. Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert und selbstständig packst Du Herausforderungen an, triffst Entscheidungen und findest Lösungen – stets mit Blick auf das Projektziel. Kommunikation: Du schaffst klare Orientierung mit offener und transparenter Kommunikation. Gleichzeitig begegnest Du Deinem Team auf Augenhöhe – wertschätzend und verbindlich. DEINE VORTEILE: WARUM DU UNS LIEBEN WIRST! Wir bieten Dir mehr als nur einen Job: Echter Einfluss: Verantwortung, Entscheidungsfreiheit und Projekte, die Deinen Stempel tragen. Wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur: Ein respektv

jobs.title: CRO Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Du baust als erste CRO-Person das Testing für Shops mit rund 250.000 Besuchen im Monat auf — und entscheidest selbst, was live geht. Die größte DTC-Marke unseres Kunden wächst im Direktgeschäft um rund 60 % pro Jahr, und Performance Marketing legt gerade kräftig nach. Allein in den letzten 30 Tagen kamen rund 250.000 Besuche in den Shop. Der Traffic ist also da — jetzt entscheidet sich, wie viel davon zu Umsatz wird. Dafür gibt es diese Rolle. Du holst Conversion Rate Optimization ins Haus und baust Testing-Prozess und Roadmap neu auf: Landingpages, Produktseiten, Homepage, Cart und Checkout. Das Ziel ist klar: den Umsatz pro Besucher in den ersten 6–12 Monaten um 40–50 % steigern. Du nimmst Tests selbst live und rollst Gewinner selbst aus, ein eigener Entwickler setzt um. Und du baust nicht nur für eine Marke. Supplement Hub vereint sieben Marken mit über 500 Produkten und rund 50–60 Mio. € Umsatz. Was in unserem größten Shop funktioniert, wird zum Playbook für die ganze Gruppe — mit der Perspektive, CRO gruppenweit zu verantworten. Warum es diese Rolle gibt Supplement Hub ist über starke Produkte und Amazon groß geworden. Im Direktgeschäft wächst unsere größte Marke schnell — mit über 200.000 Kund:innen. CRO lief bisher über eine Agentur. Das reicht für das, was jetzt kommt, nicht mehr: Mit jedem Euro mehr im Performance Marketing wird jeder Prozentpunkt Conversion wertvoller. Deshalb holen wir das Thema ins Haus. Das DTC-Team wird gerade neu aufgebaut. Wir suchen niemanden, der Agentur-Ergebnisse durchwinkt, sondern jemanden, der die Zielgruppe so gut versteht, dass daraus Tests mit echtem Umsatzhebel entstehen. Was du bewegen wirst Nicht als Aufgabenliste, sondern als das, was in zwölf Monaten anders sein soll: Du kennst die Zielgruppe besser als jeder Report. Bedürfnisse, Einwände und Kaufängste sind erforscht — mit Microsoft Clarity, Shop-Daten, Reviews und Umfragen — und fließen direkt in deine Hypothesen. Die Test-Roadmap läuft. jobs.title: Creative Technologist
jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role Our models need someone who knows them inside out — not just what they can do today, but what nobody has tried yet. You'll create the work that makes people realize what's possible with generative media: original pieces, experiments, and creative assets that set the standard for what FLUX can do, and show it to the world.
